questions.question: In a party hall, there are people in blue and red dresses. The ratio of number of men in blue to the number of Women in red is 3 ∶ 7, The ratio of men in red to the number of women in blue is 2 ∶ 1. If the ratio of number of people in blue to the number of people in red is 35 ∶ 76, then what is the ratio of number of men to the number of women?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Ratio of Men in blue (M_b) to Women in red (W_r): 3 ∶ 7

Ratio of Men in red (M_r) to Women in blue (W_b): 2 ∶ 1 

Ratio of People in blue (P_b) to People in red (P_r): 35 ∶ 76

**Solution:**

Men in Blue (MB) = 3x

Women in Red (WR) = 7x

Men in Red (MR) = 2y

Women in Blue (WB) = y

People in Blue (PB) = Men in Blue + Women in Blue = 3x + y

People in Red (PR) = Men in Red + Women in Red = 2y + 7x

(3x + y)/(7x + 2y) = 35/76

76(3x + y) = 35(7x + 2y)

228x + 76y = 245x + 70y

17x = 6y

x = 6y/17 ----(1)

Men = MB + MR = 3x + 2y = 3(6y/17) + 2y = 18y/17 + 2y

Women = WR + WB = 7x + y = 7(6y/17) + y = 42y/17 + y

Men/Women = (18y/17 + 2y)/(42y/17 + y)

(18y + 34y)/(42y + 17y)

Men/Women = 52/59

**So, the ratio of men to women is 52 : 59.**

A and B together can fill a tank in 10 hours

B and C together can fill the same tank in 12 hours

A and C together can fill the same tank in 15 hours

**Formula used:**

For combined work, 1/(time of work) equals to sum of rates of work

**Solution:**

⇒ 1/A + 1/B = 1/10

⇒ 1/B + 1/C = 1/12

⇒ 1/A + 1/C = 1/15

**Therefore, the time taken by pipe B alone to fill the tank is 120/7 hours **

questions.question: P sells a toy to Q at a profit of 40 percent and Q sells it to R at a profit of 10 percent. If R pays Rs. 539 for the toy, then what was the cost price of toy for P?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **Ratio Method** for successive profit transactions.

Profit 1 (P to Q) = 40% = 2/5 → Ratio of **CP : SP** = 5 : 7

Profit 2 (Q to R) = 10% = 1/10 → Ratio of **CP : SP** = 10 : 11

Combined Ratio (P : R) = (5 × 10) : (7 × 11) = 50 : 77

Given R pays 77 units = **Rs. 539** ⇒ 1 unit = 539 ÷ 77 = 7

Cost Price for P = 50 units = 50 × 7 = **Rs. 350**

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit percentage of **P** = 40%

Profit percentage of **Q** = 10%

Final price paid by **R** = Rs. 539

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c2fdc9c08eaf1fc11bc062ff343817041a5cced5107a9473d340f00619249d9.png] 

**Formula:** Final SP = CPᵢₙᵢₜᵢₐₗ × (1 + P₁/100) × (1 + P₂/100)

Let the cost price for **P** be **x**.

⇒ x × (1 + 40/100) × (1 + 10/100) = 539

⇒ x × (140/100) × (110/100) = 539

⇒ x × 1.4 × 1.1 = 539

⇒ x × 1.54 = 539

⇒ x = 539 ÷ 1.54

⇒ x = 350

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Profit Percentage

When two profits x% and y% occur successively, the effective profit is given by [x + y + (xy/100)]%.

Cost Price from Selling Price

If an item is sold at a profit of P%, then Cost Price (CP) = [Selling Price (SP) × 100] ÷ (100 + P).

Successive Transactions

In a chain of transactions, the selling price for one person becomes the cost price for the next person in the sequence.</p

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

4 × 6 - 3 + 8 = 14
questions.solution:
Given equation: 4 × 6 - 3 + 8 = 14 .

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) 3 and 6**

Given: 4 × 6 - 3 + 8 = 14 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**4 × 3**__ - 6 + 8 = 14 

⇒ __**12**__ - 6 __**+ 8**__ = 14 

⇒ __20 - 6__ = 14

⇒ **14 = 14**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Option 2) 6 and 4

Given: 4 × 6 - 3 + 8 = 14 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**6 × 4**__ - 3 + 8 = 14 

⇒ __**24**__ - 3 __**+ 8**__ = 14

⇒ __32 - 3__ = 14

⇒ 29 ≠ 14

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 3 and 8

Given: 4 × 6 - 3 + 8 = 14 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**4 × 6**__ - 8 + 3 = 14 

⇒ __**24**__ - 8 __**+ 3**__ = 14 

⇒ __27____ - 8__ = 14

⇒ 19 ≠ 14

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 8 and 14

Given: 4 × 6 - 3 + 8 = 14 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**4 × 6**__ - 3 + 14 = 8 

⇒ __**24**__ - 3 __**+ 14**__ = 8 

⇒ __38 - 3__ = 8

⇒ 35 ≠ 8

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: What is the chemical name of Marble?

__
 
• Calcium carbonate

 
 
• Calcium carbonate, often known as CaCO3, may be found in almost every part of the planet and accounts for more than 4% of the crust of the earth.
 
• Chalk, limestone, and marble are their most prevalent forms in nature.
 
• These three stones were formed over the course of millions of years by the sedimentation of the fossilized shells of small fossilized snails, shellfish, and coral.
 
• Although there is no difference between any of the three forms in terms of their chemical composition, there are other ways in which they are distinct from one another, including purity, whiteness, thickness, and homogeneity.

• **Calcium oxide**

 
 
• CaO is the chemical formula for calcium oxide.
 
• Calcium and oxygen are the two primary elements that makeup calcium oxide.
 
• In order to make it, calcium carbonate (like limestone) is heated to temperatures between 500 and 600 degrees Celsius in a special kiln called a lime kiln, where it breaks down into oxide and carbon dioxide.
 
 
 
• **Calcium bicarbonate**
 
 
• ​Ca(HCO3)2 is the chemical formula for calcium bicarbonate, which is also known as calcium hydrogen carbonate.
 
• Calcium bicarbonate is often referred to as cleaning lime.
 
• Both sodium bicarbonate and this compound contain bicarbonate, which is composed of hydrogen, carbon, and oxygen atoms.
 
• The formation of caverns, stalagmites, and stalactites results in the production of cleansing lime, which only exists in liquid form.
 
 
 
• **Calcium hydroxide**
 
 
• ​Calcium hydroxide, often known as slaked lime, is represented by the chemical formula Ca(OH)2. 
 
• In its solid form, this inorganic chemical appears white and powdery.
 
• On the other hand, crystallized Ca(OH)2 looks completely colorless.
